header.title: Give
header.description: Your generosity helps us advance the Gospel, serve our community, support missions, and strengthen the work of Winners Chapel International Wisconsin.

introduction.title: Give your kingdom seeds
introduction.description: Thank you for your generosity and commitment to the work of God. Choose the giving method that is most convenient for you using the instructions provided below.

methodsHeading.title: Choose how you would like to give
methodsHeading.description: In addition to online giving, you can support the church through Zelle, cheques, cash, or the designated Shiloh Sacrifice account.

methods.title: Give through Zelle
methods.description: Use your banking app to make a Zelle payment to the church using the details below.

methods.title: Give through Tithe.ly
methods.description: Give online through our Tithe.ly giving form, or download the Tithe.ly app and select Winners Chapel International, Wisconsin.

methods.title: Give by cheque
methods.description: Make your cheque payable to the church using the official name below.

methods.title: Give by cash
methods.description: If you would like to give by cash during a church service, please obtain a giving envelope from one of the ushers.

methods.title: Shiloh Sacrifice
methods.description: For Shiloh Sacrifice giving, the bank details provided by the church are listed below.

methodsNote: Please verify bank details and payment instructions with the church if you have any questions before making a transfer.

closing.title: Thank you for partnering with the work of God.
closing.description: Every gift supports the mission of the church and helps us serve our community. We are grateful for your generosity.
